d:
'Babuji Zara Dheere Chalo' from 'Dum' showcases Yana Gupta sizzling in the ultimate 'Item number'. This Bollywood action film is directed by E. Nivas. The starcast of the film consists of Vivek Oberoi, Diya Mirza, Govind Namdeo and Atul Kulkarni. The song features Sukhwinder Singh and Sonu Kakkar's voices and is composed by Sandeep Chowtha.
Credits:
Song Name - Babuji Zara Dheere Chalo
Movie - Dum
Singer - Sukhwinder Singh and Sonu Kakkar
Composer - Sandeep Chowta
Lyricists - Sameer Anjaan
Music Label - Sony Music Entertainment India Pvt. Ltd.
